pattern_name: Tagged-Dispatch If/Else Chain to Lookup Table
variant_desc: 8-way if/else chain over irregular tag bytes (no switch -> jump-table possible) -> single-load weight table
novelty_rationale: Tests recognizing that an if/else chain dispatching on irregular byte values should be replaced by a lookup table. Compilers do not perform this transformation because the discriminant values are non-contiguous (defeating jump-table generation) and the dispatch arms have different right-hand sides that the compiler cannot prove correspond to a single load-then-fma pattern.
